//: Twitwa does not build on EAS. Release APKs are built locally with gradlew and signed by the key described in README, 'Signing the release'. A build profile here would be a SECOND signing source of truth: an EAS build generates and uses its own keystore, and an APK signed by a different key cannot be installed over one signed by ours - Android refuses it, and the recipient sees only 'App not installed'. So there are deliberately no build profiles. 'eas build' will fail with a missing-profile error, which is the intended outcome: read README instead of adding a profile here.
